text:
mira: hitting a weird install failure when onboarding the sample-app for python-sdk. poetry install works locally but CI (pip + venv) pulls a cached wheel from our internal index that is missing the package data.
sam: ugh. what error do you see?
mira: ImportError: cannot import name 'TypedDict' from 'typing_extensions' even though typing-extensions 4.6 is in the lockfile. Only happens in CI where we use pip to install the exported requirements.txt.
leah: is CI using --no-deps or a pinned constraint? sometimes poetry export and pip resolver disagree.
mira: we export with `poetry export -f requirements.txt --without-hashes --output reqs.txt` and then pip install -r reqs.txt in the build step. The wheel coming from our artifactory has tag cp311-none-any but actually was built on cp310 and lacked the stub files.
jordan: can you paste the pip log?
mira: sure: ```ERROR: Could not find a version that satisfies the requirement typing-extensions==4.6.3 (from -r reqs.txt (line 12))``` then a few lines later pip chooses the cached wheel from our index and installs, but the wheel metadata is wrong.
sam: try clearing pip cache on CI runner? `pip cache purge` before install. also check `--no-binary :all:` to force sdist if wheel is busted.
leah: another workaround: `poetry export --with dev -f requirements.txt --output=requirements.txt --dev` then in CI use `pip install --no-build-isolation --no-binary typing-extensions -r requirements.txt` to force a rebuild. not great but unblocks.
mira: tried pip cache purge, still pulled the wheel from artifactory. suspect proxy caching there. opened a ticket with infra.
devops-bot: build #4521 failed on step "pip install -r reqs.txt" — see https://ci.internal/4521
jordan: can you add a short repro to the sample-app repo? then we can pin a CI job to reproduce and add a fix.
mira: created gist with minimal repro and linked to PR: https://github.com/redwood/sample-app/pull/77 — includes `pyproject.toml` and `requirements.txt` plus failing log.
sam: also check if poetry's lock has `typing-extensions` resolved to a wheel-only distribution. poetry sometimes records platform markers that confuse pip exported requirements.
leah: filing a tracking issue in SDK repo for better docs about export->pip flow and guidance for CI: https://github.com/redwood/sdk-python/issues/314
mira: thanks. temporary fix in CI: `pip install --upgrade pip setuptools wheel` then `pip install --no-binary :all: -r reqs.txt` until artifactory is fixed. :thumbsup:
sam: please paste exact commands, i'll add them to the PR CI step.
mira: commands i added: ```python -m pip install --upgrade pip setuptools wheel
pip cache purge
pip install --no-binary :all: -r reqs.txt
```
jordan: great. we should also add a short note in onboarding guide about exporting from poetry -> pip and common traps.
leah: yup — adding a small section under devex docs.
mira: marking this thread resolved for now once CI green. will update issue with root cause from infra ticket. :white_check_mark:
